description: This file contains styles and theme variables for a Tic Tac Toe interactive game built with React. It includes CSS variables for theming, as well as styles for different components of the game such as the game container, squares, buttons, and responsive design for different device sizes.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Container for the game layout, using Flexbox for centering.

classes.name: status
classes.description: Displays the current game status (e.g., whose turn it is or if there's a winner).

classes.name: board
classes.description: Styling for the game board, arranged as a grid.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Individual square in the game board where players mark their moves.

classes.name: winner
classes.description: Styling for indicating the winning state of the game.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application styling that applies to the root component.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section styling for the app.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes.
